correctness.rationale: On each chart write f=a(x)+b(x)y+c(x)y^2+d(x)y^3. In characteristic two f=f_y=0 is equivalent to a+cY=b+dY=0 for Y=y^2. Where d is nonzero substitute Y=b/d into f_x squared; where c is nonzero use Y=a/c. The cross condition is ad+bc=0; a univariate polynomial gcd, saturated away from the chosen denominator, detects any common geometric root. At a=b=c=d=0, f_x has a geometric root in y iff it is nonconstant or identically zero. This supplies an exact geometric smoothness check independent of the source's Gröbner bases. The six invertible bilinear planes give graph conics: evenness is exactly the vanishing of the three odd binary-sextic coefficients. On each of the nine rank-one planes, the odd-degree restriction to either ruling must have its only odd multiplicity at their intersection; dividing by that point's linear factor leaves a nonzero square. Smooth ampleness gives irreducibility, so no hyperplane contains the curve or a ruling component; adjunction gives the canonical polarization. Independent bit-polynomial code and orbit closure under swaps and shears regenerated all five certificate fields for every orbit row: 1,075 orbits covering 65,535 equations, including 252 smooth orbits with 16,020 equations. It independently returned (5208,8076,2556,120,60) and extremal (mask, size, conic/rulings split) (0x29e3,18,2/2), (0x2de6,36,3/1), (0x7889,6,4/0).
residual_risks: Exact finite verification in this domain, not formal proof certification. The domain counts fixed-coordinate split-quadric forms, not abstract curves or nonsplit forms.

originality.rationale: The earlier proper-tritangent record has a different headline predicate, but its released full_census_output.txt already tabulates the joint fixed-coordinate counts of proper and even-contact planes. Marginalizing the even coordinate gives exactly the advertised histogram, including the maximum and the number attaining it. Its accompanying enumerator already computes each smooth orbit representative, orbit size and constituent even-plane counts; the new extremal orbit labels and split are a direct selection of existing per-orbit quantities, with no new contact calculation.
residual_risks: Uninspected Xarles companion data may contain older equivalences; finding the earliest appearance is not necessary to reject the present novelty claim.

value.rationale: The fixed-coordinate rational contact distribution is a natural exact invariant. Here it is the marginal of a released exact table, and the extremal refinements are an elementary extraction from the same published per-orbit classification computation. Independent recomputation adds confidence but does not fill a new mathematical gap.
residual_risks: This decision is claim-specific and does not rule out value for a new invariant of the census not supplied by the prior data and calculations.
